title: Newhalo app section
description: A software section on paper: a tall rounded photo with a large orange play tile in its centre on the left; on the right an amber-to-red app tile beside a 64px heading, a paragraph, and feature rows at the bottom that open as white cards (the open card's tile turns into an orange minus). The photo blooms in.
notes: the play tile is a plain button: wire it to your own video player
name: newhalo-product-app

props.name: title
props.description: the 64px heading beside the app tile

props.name: appIcon
props.description: the icon on the amber→red app tile

props.name: features
props.description: the features that open as white cards

props.name: media
props.description: the tall photo or video on the left; empty shows the placeholder

props.name: playLabel
props.description: screen-reader name of the orange play tile on the media; leave out to hide it
